matching.toleranceRule: target and measured must have the same nonzero sign; abs(target) >= minimumAbsoluteTarget; absolute error <= max(maximumAbsoluteDeltaError, maximumRelativeDeltaError * abs(target))
matching.acceptanceRule: Freeze one signed parameter per scene class and direction from that class's tuning variant; report achieved signed mean delta Y on its acceptance variant without refitting. This experimental effect normalization is not a universal slider mapping.

primary.contrastFormula: For each known line pixel, log2(line Y / nearby same-half background Y), comparing the first background neighbor at offsets [-2,-1,1,2] in that order. Mean the relative error within each half; then equal-weight the two half means.
primary.aggregation: Equal-weight mean over bright-line/dark-background and dark-line/bright-background regions and the four matched moderate (+/-20) directions. Report each region/direction separately. +/-40 are stress diagnostics with a critical veto only when matched. No noise-energy or clipping credit.
primary.roi: Input-defined bright line Y>0.8 on dark background Y<0.1 in upper half; dark line Y<0.1 on bright background Y>0.8 in lower half. Exclude outer 2 pixels and rows within 2 pixels of the half boundary. Empty half is missing evidence.

requiredMissingUntilMeasured: Licensed developed RAW and photographic critical scenes with declared target profiles and range provenance
Recorded blind visual acceptance including skin, fine texture, branches, SDR/P3, HDR and alpha
Production prefix/contrast/white/black/NaturalBalance/automatic-control staging, full mask equivalence, undo/persistence and backup integration
Actual small and large RAW decoding, render-lane contention, cancellation and stale UI publication, CPU/GPU equivalence
Matched texture and per-profile HDR/clipping evaluation beyond the procedural diagnostics

transferContract.gain: common positive linear RGB gain; no cube clamp
transferContract.radius: nativeLong*0.015 scaled by outputLong/nativeLong; rounded, minimum one output pixel
transferContract.border: replicated-edge separable box, alpha-normalized, no coefficient averaging
transferContract.productionIntegration: only a complete Go; synthetic mode cannot grant it
